# Read-only reference: Open3D v0.19.0

`Model.h`, `VoxelBlockGridImpl.h`, and `LICENSE` are unmodified upstream MIT
sources. URLs and SHA-256 are in `sources.json`. No Open3D package is installed.
The UGRP implementation independently reproduces unit support accumulation and
the strict default extraction gate `weight > 3`, not the entire TSDF engine.
Its sparse 2D occupancy candidates, one-cell view separation and miss reset are
explicit adaptations, documented in the egomap35 README. No upstream file edits.
